tests_rerun_detail.note: A parallel --rerun-tasks attempt failed in compileDebugKotlin because processDebugResources removed R.jar mid-compile. That is an environment race, not a product failure. The serial rerun compiled and executed the suite.

verification.source: Read product diff and current source. Builder review JSON was not used as authority.
verification.metadata_table: conversation_local_meta holds pinned, archived, localTitle, lastOpenedAtMs. ConversationProductivityStore writes only upsertLocalMeta.
verification.hide_path: ConversationsScreen hide/bulk hide calls JarvisViewModel.setHiddenOnDevice, which calls setArchived. No delete of conversations, messages, pending_outbound, cursor, or drafts, and no transport call.
verification.title_overlay: setLocalTitle stores trimmed text on ConversationLocalMetaEntity.localTitle. displayTitle prefers a non-blank overlay and leaves ConversationEntity.title unchanged. Test pinAndLocalTitleDoNotMutateStoredConversation asserts the stored title.
verification.share: Copy and share both go through shareOrCopy -> ShareSafeText.visibleChatText. Credential-looking substrings and JSON envelopes that look like internal payloads return null and are not copied or sent.
verification.migration: MIGRATION_4_5 only CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_local_meta and two indexes. Room builder adds MIGRATION_1_2 through MIGRATION_4_5 and has no fallbackToDestructiveMigration. Schema 5.json adds conversation_local_meta only.
verification.unchanged: git diff --name-only and git diff --raw for contract, app/.../contract, app/.../contract/webv1, and app/.../transport are empty versus 7e93eb3.
verification.states: ConversationListEmpty covers empty chats, empty search, and empty hidden. ConversationStatusBanner covers offline/disconnected and auth/revoked/protocol error. Chat empty thread shows offline copy when the connection is not usable. JarvisMotion.durationMs/loopMs collapse when reduced motion is on, and the list uses scrollToItem instead of animateScrollToItem.
